questions.question: In a vision from God, the exiled prophet Ezekiel was taken to which place?
In Ezekiel's vision of the new temple, what did the bronze-looking man standing in the gateway hold in his hand?

answers.text: A linen cord and a measuring rod
A scroll and a writing reed
A trumpet and a burning lamp

questions.question: In Ezekiel's vision of the new temple, what were the tables inside the gateway porticos used for?
In Ezekiel's vision of the new temple, what was said about the priests who were sons of Zadok?

answers.text: Only they may approach the LORD to minister
Only they may live inside the holy city
Only they may stand guard at the outer gates
